capabilities: insert dates and times from named presets via ribbon, commands or calendar
type an inline trigger with day offsets like @@+3 to insert dates while writing
configure moment.js formats, day offsets and links to daily notes
create one command per preset for the palette, slash commands and hotkeys
extras: Not yet in the Community plugins directory; manual install described in external Getting started docs. Full documentation lives outside the README. No network requests or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to insert dates and times in user-defined formats from a calendar picker or a quick inline trigger.
summary: Date and time inserter that adds timestamps in custom presets via calendar, ribbon icon, commands or an inline trigger.
